MOD_SETTINGS.MOD_WEIGHT.LABEL: Enable Mod Content Weights
MOD_SETTINGS.MOD_WEIGHT.DESC: Master switch, off by default. While off, room generation is never touched; the weights below only take effect when this is on.
MOD_SETTINGS.MOD_ANCIENT_WEIGHT.LABEL: Custom Ancient Spawn Weight
MOD_SETTINGS.MOD_ANCIENT_WEIGHT.DESC: Determines the chance that, when an Ancient is generated, your mod's Ancient replaces the vanilla one.
MOD_SETTINGS.MOD_BOSS_WEIGHT.LABEL: Custom Boss Spawn Weight
MOD_SETTINGS.MOD_BOSS_WEIGHT.DESC: Determines the chance that, when the Act Boss is generated, your mod's Boss replaces the vanilla one.
MOD_SETTINGS.MOD_EVENT_WEIGHT.LABEL: Custom Event Ratio
MOD_SETTINGS.MOD_EVENT_WEIGHT.DESC: The proportion of mod events preferentially drawn when generating the event pool.
MOD_SETTINGS.BUTTON_CLICK.POS_Y.LABEL: Vertical Position (Y)
MOD_SETTINGS.BUTTON_CLICK.POS_Y.DESC: Adjusts the vertical position of the mod's custom button on screen. The horizontal position is fixed to the right edge.
MOD_SETTINGS.BUTTON_CLICK.MODE.LABEL: Click Mode
MOD_SETTINGS.BUTTON_CLICK.LONG_PRESS.DES: How long to hold before confirming.
MOD_SETTINGS.TITLE: Cute Sakiko Mod Settings
MOD_SETTINGS.EGG_TOGGLE.LABEL: Easter Egg Cards
MOD_SETTINGS.EGG_TOGGLE.DESC: Automatically obtain the Easter Egg relic at the start of the game.
MOD_SETTINGS.SCALE_PRESSURE.LABEL: Multiplayer Pressure Scaling
MOD_SETTINGS.SCALE_PRESSURE.DESC: In multiplayer, scale [gold]Pressure[/gold] applied to enemies based on player count.
MOD_SETTINGS.MONSTER_TOGGLE.LABEL: Enable Mod Monsters
MOD_SETTINGS.MONSTER_TOGGLE.DESC: If enabled, custom monsters and encounters from the mod will appear naturally.
MOD_SETTINGS.MOD_BGM_VOLUME.LABEL: Mod BGM Volume
MOD_SETTINGS.MOD_BGM_VOLUME.DESC: Controls the volume of mod-specific background music. Final Volume = Master Volume × This Value.
MOD_SETTINGS.MOD_SFX_VOLUME.LABEL: Mod SFX Volume
MOD_SETTINGS.MOD_SFX_VOLUME.DESC: Controls the volume of mod-specific sound effects. Final Volume = Master Volume × SFX Volume × This Value.
MOD_SETTINGS.AUDIO_TOGGLE.LABEL: Enable Mod Audio
MOD_SETTINGS.AUDIO_TOGGLE.DESC: If disabled, all mod sound effects and music playback will be skipped to prevent crash issues.
MOD_SETTINGS.DESCRIPTION: Settings for the Cute Sakiko Mod
MOD_SETTINGS.ANCIENT_TOGGLE.LABEL: Custom Ancient Events
MOD_SETTINGS.ANCIENT_TOGGLE.DESC: If enabled, custom Ancient events added by the mod will appear naturally in the game.
MOD_SETTINGS.CUSTOM_EVENT_TOGGLE.LABEL: Custom Events
MOD_SETTINGS.CUSTOM_EVENT_TOGGLE.DESC: If enabled, custom normal events added by the mod will appear naturally in the game.
TELEMETRY.BASIC_USAGE.DESC: Sends version, platform, language, and an anonymous install ID to estimate compatibility issues.
TELEMETRY.BALANCE.DESC: Sends this mod's balance events (character picks, card plays) for balance analysis.
TELEMETRY.DIAGNOSTICS.DESC: Sends exceptions and diagnostic context to help locate crashes.
TELEMETRY.RUN_HISTORY.DESC: Sends finished runs' vanilla data for balance analysis.
MOD_SETTINGS.REACTION_REPLACEMENT.LABEL: Enable Sticker Replacement
MOD_SETTINGS.REACTION_REPLACEMENT.DESC: Replace vanilla reaction stickers with mod character portraits.
MOD_SETTINGS.REACTION_WHEEL_SCALE.LABEL: Wheel Scale
MOD_SETTINGS.REACTION_WHEEL_SCALE.DESC: Scale of the reaction wheel. 1.0 = vanilla size.
MOD_SETTINGS.REACTION_EMOTE_SCALE.LABEL: Emote Scale
MOD_SETTINGS.REACTION_EMOTE_SCALE.DESC: Scale of the popped-out reaction emote. 3.0 = default.
